{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000009NZW3P8ETAHBX","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x192
group api "edge worker" {
  node Api "Hono API" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/api.ts"
  node Proxy "service proxy" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/service-proxy.ts"
  node Backups "backups API" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/backups/api.ts"
  node Admin "admin / KMS" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/admin.ts"
  node DataMgmt "data management" ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/data-management"
  node Purge "purge orchestr." ref="edge/packages/services/edge/src/purge-orchestrator.ts"
}
group router "router" {
  node RouterApi "WS /inbox API" ref="edge/packages/services/router/src/worker/api.ts"
  node RouterDO "RouterObject" ref="edge/packages/services/router/src/worker/router/router.ts"
  node SwarmDO "SwarmObject" ref="edge/packages/services/router/src/worker/swarm/swarm.ts"
  node Inbox "Inbox" ref="edge/packages/services/router/src/worker/inbox/inbox.ts"
}
group ext "Services" {
  node Services "db / hub / kms ..." ref="edge/packages/services"
}
edge Api -> RouterApi "mount /"
edge RouterApi -> RouterDO "WS per identity"
edge RouterDO -> SwarmDO "peer swarms"
edge RouterApi -> Inbox
edge RouterDO -> Services "DATABASE_MESSENGER"
edge Api -> Proxy "prefix routes"
edge Proxy -> Services "bindings"
edge Api -> Backups "R2 backups"
edge Api -> Admin
edge DataMgmt -> Purge "storage-purge Q"
"},"objects":[
